name: Premade C-horns — cap heat-sets, front self-tappers
source: User requests swapping v36's fastening types: reusable metal threads at the two removable cap screws, and self-tapping plastic pilots at the six metal-C-to-femur screws. This removes the incompatible 3.1mm front insert pockets. Retain the longer v36 box, cap, all transforms and motion datums. Assume M3 inserts are 5.7mm long with 4.6mm knurled OD, as in the prior roof; verify the actual stock. Front plastic threads need dry-fit/torque testing and will wear with repeated disassembly.
